acanti.msg.101: Before you is a Mexican with long hair. He wears a canvas shirt, and a red bandana covers his head.
acanti.msg.103: I take back what I said. It seems you can survive here after all.
acanti.msg.104: I underestimated the captain. It seems you can survive here after all.
acanti.msg.105: We're returning to our home harbour!
acanti.msg.200: Hey, amigo, do you speak Spanish? Good. There's something to discuss.
acanti.msg.202: You've already spoken to Cesareo? He's trying to settle in this bay. But I reckon it's a lousy idea.
acanti.msg.1202: You've already spoken to Cesareo? He's trying to settle in this bay. But I reckon it's a lousy idea.
acanti.msg.204: We're far from civilisation. Out here you can rely only on yourself. And what can we do? We have one boat and a few utensils from the ruins. Inland the peninsula is nothing but barren mountains. There's NOTHING here! Even for fish you have to sail far out, because the coast is poisoned.
acanti.msg.206: The captain led us to the wrong place! It's time to hand him the black spot and head back to Mexico. I'm not the only one who thinks so. Help us change his mind. Whatever he asks of you - do the opposite. And if he won't be swayed... then it'll come to sin. Catch my meaning?
acanti.msg.207: All right. I'll bear that in mind.
acanti.msg.208: Damn, life really has dragged you through it! Just don't tell me we'll end up the same way out here. Do you even speak Spanish? Good. There's something to discuss.
acanti.msg.210: This land hasn't felt a human foot since the day of the Apocalypse. We have to get out of here. As soon as possible.
acanti.msg.212: The captain led us to the wrong place! It's time to hand him the black spot.
acanti.msg.213: Your captain is dead. You're free to do as you like.
acanti.msg.214: This is our chance! Time to clear out of these cursed parts. But there's one more thing to do - repair the water pump on the schooner. Without it we won't get far. The schooner is moored at Fondeport.
acanti.msg.215: All right. I'll see whether it can be repaired.
acanti.msg.216: The schooner is ready to sail.
acanti.msg.217: Cesareo has reconsidered. He agrees to sail now.
acanti.msg.218: (shakes your hand firmly) Fate itself brought you to us. Farewell, amigo.
acanti.msg.1218: (embraces you warmly) Fate itself brought you to us. Farewell, amiga.
acanti.msg.219: Fate itself brought you to us. Farewell, amigo.
acanti.msg.1219: Fate itself brought you to us. Farewell, amiga.
acanti.msg.221: Will people out here really lose their human face, the way you have? Grim. We have to get out of here. As soon as possible.
acanti.msg.231: He has to understand that surviving here is impossible. Otherwise somebody will slip scorpion venom into his food!
acanti.msg.233: About that venom - not a bad idea.
acanti.msg.234: He asked me to repair the lighthouse.
acanti.msg.235: Better to wreck the lighthouse mechanism entirely, so it can never be started.
acanti.msg.236: He asked me to check the rumours of monsters on the shore.
acanti.msg.237: He asked me to get rid of the giant leeches.
acanti.msg.238: There! That's a good reason to tell him it isn't safe here.
acanti.msg.239: He asked me to survey the surrounding area.
acanti.msg.240: So lie to him! Say there's nothing here of use for survival.

acboss.msg.203: (speaking Spanish) Very good. We won't need a translator. I was already afraid nobody in these parts knew Spanish.
acboss.msg.204: The nearness of Mexico still tells, even a century after the Great War. But you live in isolation here?
acboss.msg.205: This is bad. I know English badly. (takes out a dictionary) But I have this book.
acboss.msg.206: It seems we won't manage a long conversation. But still - what is this town?
acboss.msg.207: We haven't thought of a name yet. But there used to be a small town here called San Felipe. Yes, we arrived recently. My name is Cesareo Villar Estrada. I am captain of all these unfortunate people. And so I want to know what to expect from you?
acboss.msg.208: This is San Felipe. I am Captain Cesareo Villar Estrada. And you?
acboss.msg.209: I'm just travelling through. You have nothing to worry about.
acboss.msg.210: I very much hope so. Forgive me, but we have reasons not to trust outsiders.
acboss.msg.212: Eres un amigo o un enemigo? We want to know for certain.
acboss.msg.213: Good. If you make yourself useful, we won't drive you away. That's fair.
acboss.msg.214: What can I do for you to change your opinion of me?
acboss.msg.216: We're trying to settle in a new place. It hasn't proved easy. Our fishermen need the lighthouse to put out to sea, but it doesn't work. We also need the surrounding land surveyed - we don't even have a proper map of the area. And Jan complains there are monsters in the ship graveyard. I don't believe him, but it wouldn't hurt to check. Help us, since you're here.
acboss.msg.217: All right. I'll try to sort out these problems.
acboss.msg.218: Lighthouse must be fixed. Need detailed map. Jan say he see monsters. I not believe Jan. You help us?
acboss.msg.219: I'm here on behalf of the Brotherhood of Steel. They're your neighbours. They want to make contact.
acboss.msg.251: (speaking Spanish) Well, what do you want?
acboss.msg.260: It seems the bay of San Felipe has decided to accept us. We have enough food and fresh water, we can put far out to sea, and the monsters nearby no longer threaten us. All thanks to you. Gracias, amigo. We've decided to stay here.
acboss.msg.1260: It seems the bay of San Felipe has decided to accept us. We have enough food and fresh water, we can put far out to sea, and the monsters nearby no longer threaten us. All thanks to you. Gracias, amiga. We've decided to stay here.
acboss.msg.261: That's your right. You've earned it. Good luck, Cesareo.
acboss.msg.262: Now the bay be our home. Your help save us. We are glad. Many thanks, amigo.
acboss.msg.1262: Now the bay be our home. Your help save us. We are glad. Many thanks, amiga.
acboss.msg.270: I managed to repair the lighthouse. Now your fishermen can sail out into deep water.
acboss.msg.271: Excellent work! Out in the deep the water is cleaner and the fish are better. The coast was fouled even before the Great War. So your help is beyond price. Thank you.
acboss.msg.272: Buen trabajo! Fish in sea is good. Fish by shore is bad. Your help very important.
acboss.msg.274: What's the problem with getting the lighthouse running?
acboss.msg.275: There are no spare parts out in this wilderness. We've been over every ruin in San Felipe and there's nothing of value in them. It was a small town.
acboss.msg.276: Before I go looking for parts, give me a little more of your time.
acboss.msg.277: I see. I'll go looking for parts in the neighbouring towns, if I can't repair it with my own hands.
acboss.msg.278: The lighthouse can't be repaired. The mechanism has crumbled with age.
acboss.msg.279: Mil demonios! That is very bad.
acboss.msg.280: Jan was right - there really were monsters in the ship graveyard.
acboss.msg.281: A thousand devils! We were wrong not to believe him. But you know, it seems those creatures appeared there recently. Which means they crawl up from somewhere while we aren't looking.
acboss.msg.282: Mil demonios! These monsters come by night. We not know from where.
acboss.msg.283: So we need to find and destroy the giant leeches' lair. Perhaps Jan saw where they crawl out from...
acboss.msg.284: Where is this Jan who talked about monsters?
acboss.msg.285: Last I saw him he was by the burning barrel at the village entrance.
acboss.msg.286: Before I go looking for him, allow me one more question.
acboss.msg.288: I think he's gone off to his hut in the ship graveyard.
acboss.msg.290: The survey is complete. Here's the data on the surrounding area.
acboss.msg.291: Thank you. So these parts are quite deserted. That's very good for us. That's exactly why we sailed from Mexico - so nobody would trouble us.
acboss.msg.292: Gracias. This is very useful work.
acboss.msg.294: What mapping data do you need?
acboss.msg.295: Anything! Above all we need to know the terrain and the sources of fresh water. Walk San Felipe within a radius of two sectors, that will be enough.
acboss.msg.296: All right. But first, a few more questions.
acboss.msg.298: [lie] The survey is complete. There's no fresh water anywhere.
acboss.msg.300: May I ask you a few questions?
acboss.msg.301: (points at the dictionary) Too many palabras.
acboss.msg.302: True enough, we won't manage a long conversation.
acboss.msg.303: Ask. It's good that we can speak the same language.
acboss.msg.305: I want to ask you about this village.
acboss.msg.306: As I said, we arrived here by ship recently and haven't had time to settle in. In the old days there was a small port town here called San Felipe. But by the time we came, only deserted ruins were left of it.
acboss.msg.307: So that's why they call you captain? And where's your ship?
acboss.msg.308: It's in the ship graveyard, near Jan's hut. It's a wonder we managed to sail here at all in that tub.
acboss.msg.309: And why did you leave Mexico?
acboss.msg.311: You don't want to talk about it? I understand.
acboss.msg.312: Come on, tell me, I'm curious!
acboss.msg.313: Don't worry, I won't be able to tell your secret.
acboss.msg.314: You can tell me. I'm not from Mexico.
acboss.msg.315: Tell me. You can trust me.
acboss.msg.317: All right. Let's change the subject then.
acboss.msg.318: I think you can be trusted. The truth is we fled a civil war. Mexico is unquiet now - first one force comes, then another. We decided to look for a quieter spot.
acboss.msg.320: It's simply that we backed the wrong side. So punitive troops were sent against us. We managed to fight them off. But it became clear they would simply wipe us out. To the new authorities we are traitors and enemies.
acboss.msg.322: That's why we fled Mexico. Now you understand why I didn't want to tell you? The government must not learn where we are!
acboss.msg.323: I won't tell anyone. I promise.
acboss.msg.324: Now you have powerful protectors. You needn't worry about that.
acboss.msg.325: I doubt the government gives a damn about a pitiful handful of runaways. Don't sweat it.
acboss.msg.326: So what are you - war criminals?
acboss.msg.330: You know some of them want to sail away from here?
acboss.msg.331: I'm doing what I can! Yes, these are barren lands, but a gallows waits for us back home. It's time the rest admitted we have no choice. If we can't survive here, we're doomed.
acboss.msg.332: I won't argue with you. Just know that not everyone is happy with your decisions.
acboss.msg.333: I think you'd do better to sail somewhere else. You won't survive here.
acboss.msg.334: If life in this bay proves impossible, we'll have to sail away. But to know that, the survey must be done.
acboss.msg.336: From my data it's clear there's little fresh water in the area and no fertile soil.
acboss.msg.337: Yes. But we can still use what the sea gives. At any rate - if we get the lighthouse running.
acboss.msg.341: Yes. But we can still use what the sea gives. All the more so now we have the lighthouse.
acboss.msg.342: Bad news - the lighthouse is wrecked. It simply can't be repaired.
acboss.msg.343: That's bad. But perhaps there are other settlements nearby?
acboss.msg.344: These are remote parts. On top of that there are giant leeches nearby and aggressive savages. And your people are preparing a mutiny. You won't survive here.
acboss.msg.345: A thousand devils! It seems there's no place for us in this world at all. But that's no reason to give up. We'll weigh anchor and find our own paradise island.
acboss.msg.346: Good attitude. I'll pass your decision on to Hector.
acboss.msg.347: I think you'd do better to sail somewhere else. There's no fresh water and no fertile soil here. Giant leeches and aggressive savages live nearby. The lighthouse doesn't work. And your people are preparing a mutiny. You won't survive here.
acboss.msg.350: I'm here on behalf of the Brotherhood of Steel. This powerful order wishes to know who you are.
acboss.msg.351: A thousand devils! We hoped these parts were as sealed off as a wine cork. So it seems we'll have to get along with neighbours?
acboss.msg.352: Less getting along than negotiating - or submitting. That depends on your decisions.
acboss.msg.353: Mil demonios! Son nuestros amigos o nuestros enemigos? We want to know for certain.
acboss.msg.354: Are they enemies? No. They are masters of these lands. So long as you don't make yourselves their enemies.
acboss.msg.355: So they're masters of these lands. Then let them prove they're to be reckoned with! We didn't flee Mexico to submit to yet another little empire.
acboss.msg.356: If I solve your problems, you'll change your attitude. The Brotherhood can do far more than that.
acboss.msg.357: As a representative of the Brotherhood of Steel, I've already shown what it can do. It has technology, weapons and connections. You'd do better to be friends with the order.
acboss.msg.358: This order own this land? Then let order show its strength!
acboss.msg.359: Damn it... We have no choice, do we?
acboss.msg.360: No. It seems you understand your position. I'll tell Paladin Latham you're ready to receive an envoy.
acboss.msg.361: Not quite. I'm no happier about the Brotherhood than you, and I'm looking for a way to stop them. Trust me.
acboss.msg.362: Maldita sea! This order is strength.
acboss.msg.400: What interested me most in your data was the source of fresh water. I'll send people there. Escort them and show them the place.
acboss.msg.401: I am interested in fresh water. You write: there is a spring. Show it?
acboss.msg.402: All right. I'll escort your people to the spring.
acboss.msg.403: Give me a little time to get ready for the road. I'll be back soon.
acboss.msg.404: The fresh water source has been found. You needn't worry about it any more.
acboss.msg.405: And no trouble on the way? Excellent news!
acboss.msg.408: Bad news - the spring is guarded by a warlike tribe of savages. You won't be able to handle them.
acboss.msg.409: I didn't expect that! There are too few of us and we have almost no weapons to take the spring from savages.
acboss.msg.410: Maldita sea! We have few weapon and few men. Bad. Very bad!
acboss.msg.411: I'm sorry. You'll have to use sea water.
acboss.msg.412: Let me go there once more. Perhaps I can get rid of them.
acboss.msg.420: How do I find the giant leeches' lair?
acboss.msg.421: Ask Jan, he knows more about those creatures than anyone.
acboss.msg.422: I'll do that. But a little later.
acboss.msg.423: I'll go to him right now.
acboss.msg.424: The leeches made their lair in a grotto. But after a small explosion they won't be getting out of there.
acboss.msg.425: The leeches made their lair in a grotto. I killed them all to the last one.
acboss.msg.1425: The leeches made their lair in a grotto. I killed them all to the last one.
acboss.msg.426: Yo-ho-ho! Now we're in your debt, aren't we? If not for you we'd have lost many people. Thank you.
acboss.msg.427: Yo-ho-ho! We be in your debt. Gracias!

acctzrun.msg.102: Before you is an agitated villager.
acctzrun.msg.121: Estoy diciendo la verdad. Por que no me crees?
acctzrun.msg.215: Tranquilo! (glances around) Sigueme, amigo. (beckons you somewhere with his hand)
acctzrun.msg.1215: Tranquilo! (glances around) Sigueme, amiga. (beckons you somewhere with his hand)
acctzrun.msg.216: You want to show me something? All right, let's go.
acctzrun.msg.217: No, no, first I need to speak to whoever's in charge here. Understand? Adios.
acctzrun.msg.218: (when you come out onto the shore, the villager points at his hut in the distance and then exclaims in horror) Los monstruos!
acctzrun.msg.219: Monsters over there? Er, thanks for the warning. Adios.
acctzrun.msg.247: No. We arrived a couple of years ago on a schooner. Better to ask our captain about that.
acctzrun.msg.249: What do you know about these monsters?
acctzrun.msg.250: They look like giant sea leeches with revolting tentacles in their mouths. I've never seen anything like them! They appeared after the recent storm. Washed up from somewhere in the depths, most likely. Who would have thought danger lay in wait for us out in such a wilderness?
acctzrun.msg.251: Monsters really had appeared near your hut. But I managed to drive them off.
acctzrun.msg.252: What did I tell you! Now Cesareo can't wriggle out of it! Everyone will know I was telling the truth! And they didn't believe me! But be careful - we don't know how many of those monsters there really were. Talk to Cesareo about it, he'll listen to you. Meanwhile I'll go check on my hut.
acctzrun.msg.254: Los monstruos. [Gesture that the monsters are dead]
acctzrun.msg.255: Ah! Gracias, amigo! Cuentale esto a nuestro capitan Cesareo.
acctzrun.msg.1255: Ah! Gracias, amiga! Cuentale esto a nuestro capitan Cesareo.
acctzrun.msg.256: All right. You can go back to your hut.
acctzrun.msg.257: Thank you, amigo. Now everyone will know I wasn't lying!
acctzrun.msg.1257: Thank you, amiga. Now everyone will know I wasn't lying!
acctzrun.msg.258: Do you know where the leeches came from?
acctzrun.msg.259: I think they come at night out of that grotto over there.
acctzrun.msg.260: Show me the entrance to that grotto.
acctzrun.msg.261: I'll bear it in mind. But it's better not to go in there right now.
acctzrun.msg.262: [Points at a large hill by the shore] El gruta.

acwtrpsn.msg.101: One of the residents of San Felipe. You must escort him to the spring.
acwtrpsn.msg.102: Now we have a source of fresh water! Tell Cesareo about it.
acwtrpsn.msg.111: Damn it, this place is taken by savages!
acwtrpsn.msg.112: The savages have seized the spring. We can't overcome them.
acwtrpsn.msg.113: This is the only source of drinking water in the area.
acwtrpsn.msg.114: The savages won't give up the spring. What are we to do?

acwtrsvr.msg.101: Before you is a warlike savage.
acwtrsvr.msg.102: This savage will not negotiate with you about anything.

afboat.msg.200: The boat is ready to sail.
afboat.msg.202: Set out for the oil platform.
afboat.msg.203: Set out for the Puerto Penasco dock.
afboat.msg.204: Set out for the settlement by the San Felipe lighthouse.
afboat.msg.205: Set out for the pescadores' village by the platform.
afboat.msg.206: Return to the pescadores' village by the platform.

afcaptan.msg.339: Any idea what creature is wrecking the nets?

afgirl.msg.1243: As it happens I'd just been to the platform and found this tag there. Your surname is on it.

aslampar.msg.113: The lighthouse mechanism is destroyed beyond repair!

asnasos.msg.112: You skilfully repaired the water pump.

aswtrttm.msg.102: The sudden disappearance of the totem will surely frighten the savages.
aswtrttm.msg.103: The sudden disappearance of the totem would have frightened the savages. But there are no savages here any more.
aswtrttm.msg.104: The savages take the disappearance of the totems for the work of evil spirits and flee the valley!

bcboss.msg.1216: In that case remember that you are merely an uninvited guest in our lands. Don't get in our way, since you don't intend to help.
bcboss.msg.226: My village recently went through the hell of enslavement. Now I'm trying to find it protection.
bcboss.msg.268: I hope your search for protectors for Villa is even more successful.
bcboss.msg.269: I hope your search for your missing kinsmen is even more successful. By the way, our scouts reported that a group of slaves from Villa was seen on the road to Phoenix. Look there.

bcchildb.msg.1104: You're not as bad as the other outsiders. Thank you.

bcctznmt.msg.1226: Nothing is too good for our hero. Here, take a plate.

bcfortun.msg.1200: I knew you would come here one day, farm girl from Villa. A sad story befell you.
bcfortun.msg.226: Strange. The spirits are silent about your future. Everything of importance to you must already be behind you.

bcgarpst.msg.1200: Hey, look who's turned up! I know this outsider. She tried to take our brahmin near Garage City!

bcheada.msg.103: May the Sacred Brahmin of Peace preserve us!

bcheadc.msg.1218: Oh, I see a stranger in the pueblo. Who are you? What are you doing in another's tribe?
bcheadc.msg.1284: I'll bring offerings to the Divine Brahmin, so that it guides and protects you on the road. Good luck, friend.
bcheadc.msg.1291: The Divine Brahmin itself must have helped you in that hard task. Now I see I was wrong about you. Not all outsiders try to subdue us or rob us. Thank you, friend from Villa.

bchunter.msg.1221: What do you want, farm girl from Villa?

bcmisbos.msg.1227: Hm. I'm curious now as to how you earned so much trust from Aaron himself. Perhaps I should listen to your advice. But bear in mind that I still command this squad.

bcranger.msg.276: First see whether you can stand up FOR YOURSELF, FOOL!

ccboss.msg.1202: What's going on? Oh, gringa, we're celebrating the day of our saints. You've come to a feast of life! Help yourself and make yourself at home. We welcome everyone... who won't get in our way.
ccboss.msg.1230: What are you doing here, cursed gringa?! How dare you defile our sanctuary?!
ccboss.msg.1239: I see straight through you, gringa. If you died, the world would breathe easier for it. I won't let you walk out of this church.
ccboss.msg.1242: Here's the thing, gringa. Leave and never come back.
ccboss.msg.1251: For fifteen years I protected these people. And this is how they repay me! Now that El Diablo is gone, anyone at all can accuse me. And do you know how hard that sacrifice was to make? How I suffered those first years? But I did what I was chosen as elder to do - I saved the people. And now you tell me it was wrong? To hell with your opinion, cursed gringa!

ccnina.msg.1235: (pulls her hand away and pushes you off) Go home, gringa! El Diablo ya esta aqui!

ccninb.msg.1206: (falls to her knees and sobs) El Diablo... *sniff-sniff* Tu no entiendes, gringa. Vivi para esto.
ccninb.msg.1226: (falls to her knees and sobs) But El Diablo... *sniff-sniff* You don't understand, gringa. I was prepared for this my whole life. I knew this day would come.

ccnino.msg.1208: Exactly! And I like you, gringa.
ccnino.msg.1238: You're a gringa, you don't understand anything! If she puts on the crown, I won't be able to go anywhere near her. And I... I love her...

ccpapa.msg.1301: Every few months we gave him a sacrifice, raised especially for the purpose. And so nobody would lose heart, Hilario made a ceremony of it and even began preaching the idea of divine cleansing. And so we lived hand in hand with a real devil. Until you appeared, gringa.

dcbarshf.msg.105: We finish Bustos - and that's the end of it.
dcbarshf.msg.106: It all worked out very neatly. We'll put it down to a highwayman attack.

dcctzne.msg.280: Fue muy dificil cruzar el desierto. Pero lo hicimos porque no teniamos otra opcion. Primero llegamos a la ciudad de Two-Sun, y de ahN nos echaron. Luego nos quedamos en Casa Grande.
dcctzne.msg.370: Have you seen the tinkers' envoy?
dcctzne.msg.372: He didn't come back to Tucson. What do you know about it?
dcctzne.msg.373: I never told you this, amigo, but you'll find the answer to your question in the local cemetery. And don't ask me about it again.

dcmer.msg.1448: Shut your mouth and listen. I am the MAYOR OF THIS TOWN. I answer for it. And I will let NOBODY defile its good name. Who are you to judge me? Just an outsider passing through. So be on your way!
dcmer.msg.1548: Hey, where's my reward? I didn't drag myself along the hot highways with rotting flesh in a sack for nothing.

dcmerdch.msg.107: Papa is gone, and Sullivan has seized the town. And me into the bargain. How could it all turn out this way?!
dcmerdch.msg.350: Do you know what happened to the tinkers' envoy?
dcmerdch.msg.351: I'll tell you in confidence: he's already in a grave. Go to the cemetery and check, if you don't believe me.
dcmerdch.msg.352: Damn, that's not a pleasant errand...

dcmerstp.msg.104: Time to clear out of here...
dcmerstp.msg.105: Whoa, whoa! I'm not taking any part in this!
dcmerstp.msg.106: Looks like it's time I left this town. Damn, and it all started so well...
dcmerstp.msg.270: Is it true that Bustos is holding a highwayman?
dcmerstp.msg.271: That's right. They were torturing him in the bathroom just now. But the little swine is tough, you won't crack him easily.

dcwtratk.msg.217: Nooo! [try to hug and calm them]

dcwtrbos.msg.1103: Tired of living? Get out of town, you damned bandit!
dcwtrbos.msg.104: I'll bring my own order to this town. Relax and take a bath. I told the trader to give you a discount.
dcwtrbos.msg.1231: No problem. I saw nothing and I heard nothing.
dcwtrbos.msg.252: Thanks, I'll go ask the mayor.
dcwtrbos.msg.253: I'm tracking a convoy of slaves. It was heading for Tucson.
dcwtrbos.msg.254: Then go to Tucson. It's further south along the highway. Caravans don't linger here for long.
dcwtrbos.msg.255: Thanks, now I know where to go.
dcwtrbos.msg.320: Try asking the mayor. There's no more work at my station.
dcwtrbos.msg.321: I don't think so. There's no more work at this station.
dcwtrbos.msg.322: All right. Can I take a little more of your time?
dcwtrbos.msg.330: About the pump. What's the problem with repairing the filter?
dcwtrbos.msg.331: The tinkers skin you three times over for any service. They know water is the most valuable resource there is. But we can't give them everything. And apart from the tinkers, nobody can handle that kind of work. Only they have the machines, the knowledge and the skills.
dcwtrbos.msg.333: The filter is in order. Dirt and sand ruined some of the parts, but I managed to restore them.
dcwtrbos.msg.334: For work like that I don't grudge the payment. Take it, here's
dcwtrbos.msg.338: For a larger sum I wouldn't have offered the job at all.
dcwtrbos.msg.341: That barely covers the cost of the extra parts.
dcwtrbos.msg.350: I know you have your differences with Bustos. Do you want to talk about it?
dcwtrbos.msg.353: You had differences with Bustos. So do the highwaymen. Maybe we could join forces?
dcwtrbos.msg.354: What the hell are you talking about?
dcwtrbos.msg.356: The highwaymen want to overthrow the mayor. They'll never come to terms with him. But with you they might.
